visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a brown knit beanie and a dark red sweater sits at a wooden table facing the camera. In front of her sits a large, disorganized pile of black mahjong tiles featuring the ROG logo. To her left is a large red and yellow Chinese fortune decoration. (2) The scene shifts to another woman wearing a pink floral cardigan with several strings of red decorative toy firecrackers draped around her neck; she introduces the game concept with a smile. (3) The camera focuses in a top-down close-up on the black mahjong tiles as several hands reach in to shuffle them vigorously across the table surface. (4) The woman in the red sweater is seen carefully feeling the surfaces of the tiles with her fingertips, eyes closed or looking away, attempting to identify the characters by touch alone. (5) She reveals her chosen tiles, and a graphic overlay appears showing her 'prize' based on the numbers. (6) A third woman in a white turtleneck and beige scarf participates, laughing as she gingerly picks through the black tiles. (7) The woman in the pink floral cardigan returns for her turn, showing intense concentration and frustration as she feels the tiles. (8) Upon revealing a high-value tile, the woman in the pink cardigan reacts with extreme joy, jumping up and performing a somersault backward on the floor behind the table.

The sound of shuffling feet and fabric rustling accompanies the energetic movements of the characters. (5) A final stinger sound effect and a celebratory shout end the audio track, maintaining high arousal until the last second.
